entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-05-19
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Perf regression: kestrel-hostheader-mismatch #66746
  • Fix `TempData` and `SupplyParameterFromSession` to support streaming SSR #66745
    11.0-preview6
  • Publish guidance of how (not) to use `SetIsOriginAllowed(_ => true)` (CORS) #66740
  • Add annotation for rendering of the RenderFragments in the case of serialization #66739
    11.0-preview6
  • Perf regression: tls-handshakes-kestrel #66734
  • ASP.NET Core Web App(Razor/MVC) shows Unhandled ILCompiler IndexOutOfRangeException when property group PublishReadyToRun=true in .NET 11 Preview 5 #66733
  • Failed to log in with passkey for Blazor Web Individual app after installing .NET 11.0 preview 5 SDK #66732
  • Expose some internal Blazor APIs to allow customization for form and querystring deserialization #66731
    Backlog

Closed

  • Blazor SessionData #64422
    11.0-preview5
  • [Blazor] Support serializing render fragments from SSR #52768
    11.0-preview5
  • Benchmark stopped running: blazorwasmbenchmark #66357
  • Benchmark stopped running: blazorwasmbenchmark #64919
  • Benchmark stopped running: QueryCompilation #66689
  • Benchmark stopped running: QueryCompilation #66618
  • Benchmark stopped running: QueryCompilation #65180
  • Benchmark stopped running: QueryCompilation #64046
  • When prerendering, emit culture name and use it on WebAssembly side #26941
    Backlog
  • KeyRingProvider causes thread pool starvation on cold start in .NET 10 #66380
  • Incomplete display name resolution in Microsoft.Extensions.Validation #65647
    11.0-preview5
  • [Mono debug] When debugging Blazor WASM project with the Mono debugger option enabled, vs displays "Operation not supported. Unknown error: 0x80004005" and then crash and restart #66690

PullRequests

Created

  • Add workaround for ReadyToRun publish regression in .NET 11 Preview 5 #66742
    area-infrastructure, community-contribution
  • [release/10.0] Fix KeyRingProvider thread pool starvation on cold start #66737
    area-dataprotection
  • [release/9.0] Fix KeyRingProvider thread pool starvation on cold start #66736
    area-dataprotection, 9.0.x

Merged

  • SupplyParameterFromSession support for Blazor #65184
    area-blazor, 11.0-preview5
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #66741
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, build-ops, 11.0-preview5
  • RenderFragment serialization #66528
    area-blazor, 11.0-preview5
  • (follow-up) fix KeyRingProvider thread pool starvation on cold start #66743
    area-dataprotection, 11.0-preview5
  • Replace Blazor WebAssembly DevServer with Gateway in templates #66729
    area-blazor, 11.0-preview5
  • Fix ServerVirtualizationTest #66738
    area-blazor, 11.0-preview5
  • Added Culture persistence between Client and Server #63144
    area-blazor, 11.0-preview5
  • Fix KeyRingProvider thread pool starvation on cold start #66683
    area-dataprotection, 11.0-preview5

Updated

  • Add FileExtensionSignInfo for .cab to fix unsigned cab files inside ANCM MSIs #66443
    community-contribution, needs-area-label
  • Make dotnet-user-secrets Native AOT compatible #66663
    area-commandlinetools
  • Fix WindowsCertificateManager to correctly detect user cancellation of trust dialog #66604
    needs-area-label
  • [blazor][wasm] use dotnet.download() for InteractiveAuto #66656
    area-blazor, 11.0-preview5
  • [blazor] E2E test coreCLR WASM #66331
    area-blazor, .NET 11 Planning
  • Add HttpSys wrapper interface for HttpQueryRequestProperty Windows API #66700
    area-networking
  • RateLimitingMiddleware implements IDisposable to avoid leaking timers #66435
    community-contribution, area-middleware
  • Make DefaultActionDescriptorCollectionProvider implement IDisposable #66426
    area-mvc, community-contribution
